keyEvents.text: Aaron Quirós (Atlante) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Atlante. Diogo Bagüí replaces Joaquín Moxica.
Felipe Sánchez (Santos Laguna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Tahiel Jiménez replaces Jonathan Pérez.
Second Half begins Atlante 0, Santos Laguna 0.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Kevin Palacios replaces Eduardo Aguirre.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Javier Güémez replaces Fran Villalba.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Aldo López replaces Facundo Cáseres.
Delay in match because of an injury Gustavo Sánchez (Atlante).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Atlante 0, Santos Laguna 1. Tahiel Jiménez (Santos Laguna) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ezequiel Bullaude.
Aldo López (Santos Laguna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atlante. Daniel González replaces Walter Clar.
Goal! Atlante 0, Santos Laguna 2. Esteban Lozano (Santos Laguna) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Mauricio Cuevas following a fast break.
Substitution, Atlante. Maximiliano García replaces Eugenio Pizzuto.
Substitution, Atlante. Luis Puente replaces Gustavo Sánchez.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Luis Gómez replaces Ezequiel Bullaude.
